name: Book of Aneirin
text: The Book of Aneirin is known in Welsh as Llyfr Aneirin. It is a manuscript copied in the middle of the thirteenth century. It rests now in the South Glamorgan library. Most of its writing shows thirteenth-century spelling, while a fifth carries older forms. The codex is the chief carrier of the poem Gododdin. Aneirin gave that verse its voice, so a note in the text says his name. The work stands apart from the Canu Aneirin, another collection of the same bard.

attributes.attribute: a Welsh manuscript of the thirteenth century

okr.objective: Present the Book of Aneirin and its famous Gododdin poem.
key_results: It is a Welsh manuscript copied in the thirteenth century.
It preserves poetry of the Cross of Aneirin.
The Gododdin is its famous poem.

sources: MacKillop 2008, s.v. Book of Aneirin and Aneirin.
